summary: Turbo Energy, S.A., a Spanish foreign private issuer listed on the NYSE American, furnished a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, covering the second quarter. The filing reports ordinary-course results, segment and geographic revenue, share capital, restricted stock units, customer concentration and bank credit facilities with Bankinter, BBVA, Santander, Sabadell, CaixaBank and Enerfip. No special-situation transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine semi-annual earnings report, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
